queries:
WITH g AS (
    SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS group_avg
    FROM "order" o
    INNER JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE o.amount > 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT account_id,
       region,
       group_avg,
       group_avg - (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM g) AS difference
FROM g
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) FROM `order` GROUP BY k_symbol HAVING AVG(amount) > 2802;
